name: Panjyamon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 green or blue Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from your hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play another Digimon by an effect, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
